metadata.value:
As an Account Development Specialist (End-User), you will be on the front lines of customer engagement — identifying, contacting, and selling to new and existing end-user customers and regionally based Engineering firms who could benefit from our products or services. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on direct outreach, enjoys helping people solve problems, and wants to build foundational sales skills in a fast-paced environment. This role is responsible for driving sales of all relevant end-user-focused products by combining a blend of technical knowledge, strategic thinking, and exceptional communication skills. The Account Development Specialist works closely with our Channel and Field Application Engineering teams to ensure customer satisfaction and achieve sales targets.  This role plays a pivotal part in the development of accounts, with the goal of crossing a threshold to where developed accounts are then assigned to Sales Engineers. This position is an individual contributor role and does not include formal people management responsibilities.  

	COMPETENCY PROFILE: 
•	Global Competencies: Collaborate; Deliver Results; Develop Yourself; Drive Customer Value; Improve and Innovate; Take Ownership

RESPONSIBILITES:
•	Meet or exceed territory sales quotas as established by the RSM and/or Vice President—Field Sales.
•	Be proficient in BASE selling skills and implement to build strong customer relationships.
•	Generate leads through cold calls, emails, and networking events.
•	Support the preparation of proposals, presentations, and sales materials
•	Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate client information. Fully utilize the CRM as a communication, reporting, measurement, and tracking tool to enhance productivity.
•	Collaborate with the entire Phoenix Contact team to align efforts, effectively communicate both verbally and written.
•	Track and report on business development activities and performance metrics.
•	Differentiate Phoenix Contact from other component vendors by building “partner” relationships with customers.
•	Focus on the customer by averaging a minimum of 20 sales calls per week
•	Be proficient in and drive the use of all sales tools provided to support local markets.
•	Work closely with Harrisburg Product teams to aid in the development of field presentations and application notes.
•	Proactively utilize all resources and sales tools to maximize productivity, responsiveness, and customer delight.
•	Continue personal development through an effective skill-building program as determined by the RSM, Director of Sales, and/or the Harrisburg Training Department.
•	Demonstrate technical competence on all products/solutions within the area of focus.
•	Provide forecasts and reports to RSM as required.
•	Independently and/or in conjunction with regional management, develop and implement effective Mutual Action Plans with assigned distributor locations.
•	Deliver presentations and hands-on demonstrations of Phoenix Contact products, applications, and technology for the purpose of product sales.
•	Develop and maintain a working knowledge on all Phoenix Contact products/solutions.
•	Qualify and follow up on all leads within the assigned territory.
•	Follow up on all quotations within the assigned territory for the given account portfolio.
•	Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Four-year degree preferred.
•	Technical discipline preferred and/or equivalent experience.
•	1 to 3 years minimum sales experience in the electronics or industrial automation & controls marketplace.
•	Experience working with distribution preferred.
•	Comfortable making cold calls and sending outreach emails.
•	Self-motivated with the ability to learn and adapt quickly.
•	Demonstrates a willingness to collaborate with others, build relationships, and involve others in decision making. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to deliver results by solving or supporting others in solving problems, prioritizing tasks, and/or resources, and focusing on outcomes. 
•	Demonstrates self-awareness and the willingness to learn and grow, accept changes, and effectively adapt to changing work demands. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to drive customer value through knowledge of the business, putting effort into identifying customer needs, and delivering work to maximize the value for customers. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to promote the value of improvement and innovation by staying ahead of trends, creating ideas and opportunities, and generating speed. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to take ownership by making decisions, taking responsibility, and driving things forward. 



ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
•	Must be able to travel via airplane.
•	Must have a valid driver’s license and be able to travel via automobile for up to six hours at a time.
•	Must be able to lift a minimum of 50 lbs.
•	Must be able to travel overnight 35-40% or as dictated by assigned territory.
•	Comply with company dress code guidelines.
•	Punctuality is required.
•	Regular and on-time attendance (Must Be Included as Worded Here by Legal).

SYNOPSIS: 
The Field Application Engineer (FAE) will provide technical, hands-on expertise to support all business opportunities for Phoenix Contact products and applications directly associated with the automation, control and networking portfolio used within the industrial automation and electronics industry. The Field Application Engineer will collaborate with regional sales managers, strategic account managers, sales engineers, account development specialists, channel, and field application engineering teams, to utilize a consultative approach with all customers to support their individual needs and expand market penetration. This role plays a pivotal part in the development and expansion of all accounts, through automation, control and networking sales growth and specifications.  This position is an individual contributor role and does not include formal people management responsibilities.  

	COMPETENCY PROFILE: 
•	Global Competencies: Collaborate; Deliver Results; Develop Yourself; Drive Customer Value; Improve and Innovate; Take Ownership

RESPONSIBILITES:
•	Increase annual sales revenue across all products directly associated with the automation, control, and networking portfolio at customer accounts. These products include but are not limited to ethernet products (wired or wireless), safety, controllers, IO, HMIs, IPCs and engineered solutions.
•	Work in coordination with local Phoenix Contact sales team utilizing joint sales activities, trainings, and mutual action plans to advance the sales of above-mentioned products.
•	Act as the local technical representative for the above-mentioned products and support the sales team in power-related technical matters.
•	Act as the regional marketing specialist developing sales tools, collateral and driving campaigns.  
•	Serve as the “voice of the customer” providing insight for expansion of product lines or new focus industries.
•	Drive value-added applications and engineered solutions. 
•	Meet/exceed territory sales quotas as established by the RSM and/or Vice President - Field Sales.
•	Be proficient in BASE selling skills and implement to build strong customer relationships.
•	Develops and maintains strong relationships with potential clients, partners, and other stakeholders to facilitate new business and sustain growth. 
•	Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate client information. Fully utilize the CRM as a communication, reporting, measurement, and tracking tool to enhance productivity.
•	Effectively communicate with the entire Phoenix Contact team, both verbally and written.
•	Be proficient in and drive the use of all sales tools provided to support local markets.
•	Active involvement in industry-related associations.
•	Proactively utilize all resources and sales tools to maximize productivity, responsiveness, and customer delight.
•	Continue personal development through an effective skill-building program as determined by the RSM, Director of Sales, and/or the Harrisburg Training Department.
•	Demonstrate technical competence on all products/solutions within area of focus.
•	Provide reports to RSM as required.
•	Deliver presentations and hands-on demonstrations of Phoenix Contact automation, control and networking products, applications, and technology for the purpose of product sales.
•	Develop and maintain a working knowledge on all Phoenix Contact automation, control, and networking products/solutions.
•	Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Four-year college degree.
•	Technical discipline preferred and/or equivalent industry experience.
•	3 years minimum sales or marketing experience with automation and industrial control products.

The Manual Assembler role is designed for high school juniors and seniors seeking         entry-level experience in production. As a Manual Assembler, you will perform various    tasks associated with assembly, ensuring the quality of your work. This position offers the flexibility to work in teams, small batch production, or flow lines. This opportunity aims to provide valuable hands-on experience in production, with the potential for future apprenticeship opportunities.

•	General Competencies: Adaptability; Communication; Customer Orientation; Analytic Thinking; Diagnostic Information Gathering; Innovation; Thoroughness.

•	Has the ability to read and understand production documentation and drawings.
•	Understands basic electronics concepts and can follow wiring schematics.
•	Performs final assembly, electrical testing, and packaging of various assemblies
•	Performs screening and separation of various parts
•	Responsible for recording assembly time data and completion of all associated routing, quality inspections, and other related forms

•	Assist in other Production areas as needed
•	Focus on increasing productivity in all activities
•	Follow necessary PPE requirements, appropriate ISO specifications and company procedures.
•	Performs other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

•	Must be at least 16 years of age by the start of the role.
•	Strong organizational skills.
•	Ability to read and comprehend English written production documents.
•	Basic computer skills.
•	Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude toward all aspects of work
•	Apply effort and energy to lifelong learning and strive to continually grow

SYNOPSIS: The Solutions Marketing Specialist is a hands-on, execution-focused role responsible for driving awareness, adoption, and commercial success of Phoenix Contact’s industrial networking, connectivity, and communications solutions across key application areas, including Transportation, Energy, and Public Safety.

This role combines solution marketing with integrated marketing execution, with a strong emphasis on digital content creation, website and CMS (Drupal) management, and campaign deployment. The Specialist develops and executes solution-based messaging, creates digital and visual assets, and manages marketing initiatives that directly support business growth.

As a proactive and self-directed contributor, this individual identifies gaps, builds new solutions and content, and drives initiatives forward—not just supporting existing programs. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, and Industry teams, the role ensures effective go-to-market execution and customer engagement across digital and traditional channels.

COMPETENCY PROFILE:
•	Global Competencies: Collaborate; Deliver Results; Develop Yourself; Drive Customer Value; Improve and Innovate; Take Ownership

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•	Support the development of a solutions-first marketing approach for industrial networking and communications technologies (e.g., switches, cellular, wireless connectivity) across Transportation, Energy, and Public Safety.
•	Identify and prioritize target applications and market segments within these ecosystems.
•	Translate product capabilities into clear, application-focused value messaging and customer-centric content.
•	Develop application-focused materials, including digital content, solution overviews, use cases, and case studies.
•	Own and manage website content, including product pages, solution pages, and landing pages, using CMS (Drupal); apply basic HTML/CSS as needed to ensure accuracy and optimization.
•	Support SEO and digital marketing initiatives through content optimization, campaign landing pages, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.
•	Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email campaigns, lead-nurturing workflows, and marketing automation using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot).
•	Create and produce digital and visual assets (e.g., graphics, presentations, videos, and campaign materials) using Adobe Creative Suite.
•	Support product positioning and the development of product launch and sales enablement materials, including product briefs, presentations, and brochures.
•	Drive execution of solution launches, campaigns, and go-to-market initiatives aligned with commercial objectives.
•	Identify gaps in marketing content, campaigns, or positioning and proactively develop solutions to address them.
•	Monitor campaign and digital performance metrics and recommend optimizations to improve engagement and outcomes.
•	Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Marketing teams to align messaging with application and market needs.
•	Support planning and execution of trade shows and events, including booth coordination, event content, and integrated campaign support.
•	Manage multiple projects and timelines to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
•	Demonstrate initiative by independently driving work forward while incorporating input from stakeholders as needed.
•	Take ownership of responsibilities by following through on commitments and demonstrating accountability.
•	Other duties as assigned by manager.

QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field 
•	Experience in product marketing, sales enablement, or digital marketing within a B2B environment 
•	Ability to translate technical information into clear, concise, customer-focused messaging 
•	Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (e.g., Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro) for content and asset creation 
•	Experience with content management systems (preferably Drupal) and website administration 
•	Working knowledge of SEO, digital analytics, and campaign performance tracking 
•	Experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Pardot) preferred 
•	Familiarity with HTML and CSS preferred 
•	Familiarity with industrial networking, ethernet switches, cellular routers, and/or wireless communications (Wi-Fi/radio) at a high level preferred
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
•	Demonstrated ability to work as a self-directed, proactive contributor, identifying needs and executing solutions independently 
•	Experience supporting industrial, technical, or application-driven markets (Transportation, Energy, Public Safety preferred)
•	Demonstrates a willingness to collaborate with others, build relationships, and involve others in decision making. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to deliver results by solving or supporting others in solving problems, prioritizing tasks, and/or resources, and focusing on outcomes. 
•	Demonstrates self-awareness and the willingness to learn and grow, accept changes, and effectively adapt to changing work demands. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to drive customer value through knowledge of the business, putting effort into identifying customer needs, and delivering work to maximize the value for customers. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to promote the value of improvement and innovation by staying ahead of trends, creating ideas and opportunities, and generating speed. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to take ownership by making decisions, taking responsibility, and driving things forward. 

SUPPORTING QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Exposure to Transportation, Energy, or Public Safety markets
•	Exposure to Networking Communications
•	Experience supporting product launches
•	Experience developing application-focused or solutions-based content
•	Familiarity with digital marketing channels (web, email, social)


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
•	10–20% travel required.
•	Must be able to sit and/or stand for extended periods (2–4 hours at a time).
•	Must be able to work on a computer for extended periods (up to 4 hours at a time).
•	Must be able to travel via automobile, train, or plane for up to 10 hours.

Job Summary 

 

The Materials Planner I role is responsible for purchasing components required for manufacturing department and/or other areas as assigned, managing execution of DPA’s (Demand Planning Agreements) in support of key Customers, managing component and finished good inventory levels, as well as planning the release of work orders to production based on incoming Customer orders, production capacity and availability of components in stock. The Materials Planner I has the primary day-to-day responsibility for ensuring the reliable flow of components from suppliers to the production floor and releasing work orders, as required to meet Customer orders.  The Materials Planner I position is a key role within our strategic plan as we drive to balance 95% on-time Customer delivery while lowering inventory dollars.  Candidate must be able to balance immediate and long-term priorities.  This includes responsibility for profitability, inventory levels, capacity planning, on-time shipment, and cost control. The Materials Planner I will collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, Strategic Purchasing and Customer Service to support the RBU’s overall growth plan. 

 

 

Responsibilities 

 

Develop and manage stock inventory levels for manufacturing based on usage and Customer stocking programs   

Develop and manage Stocking/Replenishment program for products.  Stocking programs with suppliers to minimize inventory while maximizing flexibility.  Reduce lead time of components, resulting in reducing lead times to our Customers. 

Issue purchase orders to component suppliers based on production demand and forecast 

Determine component parts where forecasting should be used and coordinate with Strategic Purchasing on supplier-bonded inventory or blanket orders 

Purchase components at the most favorable price consistent with quality, quantity, and specification requirements, as well as timely delivery of components 

Manage component EOQ, MOQ, lead time, safety stock, and replenishment reorder point planning parameters 

Provide reports on a regular basis on Customer demand planning agreements 

Support new product development and project releases 

Perform Production Planning functions within BaaN MRP modules 

Based on incoming Customer orders, required ship dates, production capacity and available component inventory, release production orders to the shop floor 

Perform daily functions within BaaN MRP modules to include: 

Confirm and transfer purchase orders from MRP session 

Release MRP and PRP production orders daily 

Review product requirements and update work order schedules based on component availability and manufacturing lead time 

Revise and coordinate production schedules with manufacturing based on customer demand 

Establish and coordinate, with manufacturing, the priority in which work orders are kitted, released, and scheduled in production 

Interface with Customer Service, Production, Shipping/Receiving, Quality, Strategic Purchasing, Engineering and Product Management 

Meet inventory targets on assigned product lines 

Coordinate, as appropriate, quality matters and engineering changes/developments between company activities and suppliers 

Proactively report product and material availability issues 

Maintain Item Master Data and revise essential planning data to ensure BaaN is effectively planning for future requirements 

Plan, schedule, and monitor the movement of materials through the development, prototype, and production cycle 

Expedite orders, as necessary. Identify actual and potential delivery problems and take proactive steps to inform appropriate personnel 

Implement improvement processes to reduce inventory and non-value-added work 

Demonstrate initiative by understanding what actions need to be taken and completing the required tasks while seeking the perspective of others as required. 

Demonstrate an honest and forthright presence by taking responsibility for own mistakes and not blaming others, and by doing what he / she commits to doing. 

Work as a team player to make a difference within the business and express gratitude and appreciation to others who have provided information, assistance, or support. 

Readily handle change through taking advantage of lifelong learning opportunities and being open minded and curious in the face of new challenges. 

Other duties as assigned by ones manager. 

 

Qualifications 

 

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering or Supply Chain Logistics 

APICS Certification is preferred 

Enhanced knowledge of Kan Ban and LEAN techniques is preferred. 

Working knowledge of MRP systems required. 

Previous experience in a production planning role in a manufacturing environment is highly desired.  

Advanced Computer knowledge in Microsoft Office is required 

Basic Print reading is preferred 

Strong Organizational, Communication and Leadership skills 

Must be able to work under pressure, handle multiple tasks and be detail oriented with a high level of accuracy 

Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with limited supervision 

Must be a self-starting, motivated  individual, open to taking on challenges and finding ways to succeed 

Excellent organizational skills, ability to balance immediate and long-term priorities 

Ability to work effectively with others and have a collaborative attitude  

Project management skills 

Read, analyze, and interpret general business documents, technical procedures, and drawings  

Ability to manage and manipulate system data and parameters to ensure company stocking levels and Customer service levels 

Work independently, establish priorities and make decisions 

Time management skills 

 

Essential Job Functions  

 

Must be proficient in spoken and written English. Some ability in spoken/written German is helpful. 

Must be available for occasional business trips when required, including international travel, for periods of up to 10 working days 

Able to sit or stand continually for four hours without a break 

Able to use computer for four hours without a break 

Attendance in accordance with Company policies 

Able to drive to local supplier, in own vehicle (with reimbursement), at short notice 

Able to work 6-day week, if required 

Must be able to lift 40 pounds 

Regular and on-time attendance.

Contribute to production performance, in addition to equipment management and implementation. Working with engineering and quality, supports the production team in achieving established targets and assures customer satisfaction. The Mechatronics Technician I will modify, maintain, and repair electrical, electronic, and mechanical components, equipment, and systems to ensure proper functioning. The Mechatronics Technician I represents the first level within the Mechatronics Technician career path.

•	Utilizes quality tools and continuous improvement techniques to improve department targets.
•	Other duties as assigned.

•	Knowledge of Mechanical assembly.
•	Demonstrate initiative by understanding what actions need to be taken and completing the required tasks while seeking the perspective of others as required. 
•	Demonstrate an honest and forthright presence by taking responsibility for own mistakes and not blaming others and by doing what he / she commits to doing. 
•	Work as a team player to make a difference within the business and express gratitude and appreciation to others who have provided information, assistance or support. 
•	Readily handle and embrace change through taking advantage of lifelong learning opportunities and being open minded and curious in the face of new challenges.

SUPPORTING QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Associate Degree in Mechatronics, Engineering Technology, or another related field; Or 1 – 3 years of relevant work experience.
•	Experience in a production environment.
•	Knowledge of industry standards.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
•	Able to lift at least 50 pounds.
•	Able to use pallet jack with 300-pound load.
•	Able to use portable staircase and climb to 12-foot heights.
•	Able to carry 20 pound/ 3 cubic feet boxes up and down portable staircase.
•	Able to push 4-wheeled cart with 100-pound load.
•	Able to work a 6-day week, if required.
•	Able to stand or sit continually for four hours without break.
•	Able to travel to offsite locations including German Headquarters for periods of up to 2 to 3 weeks.

Job Summary 

 

The role of the Product Manager I is to manage the business, customer relationships, and product lifecycle. This includes defining product requirements, pricing and forecasting, supporting engineering and manufacturing resources, and providing guidance during development projects. The Product Manager creates product roadmaps, defines key products, and identifies markets within their scope of responsibility.  This role is responsible for the complete lifecycle of the products from definition through promotion, distribution, support, and discontinuation. 

 

 

Responsibilities 

 

Guide the development and implementation of the regional business unit product roadmap by identifying regional and global product opportunities that offer significant revenue and margin potential that are within the scope of the product line and its strategic plan. 

Review opportunities presented by sales subsidiaries, customers, standards organizations, and other sources. Analyze all aspects of the opportunity and make recommendations on if and how the opportunity should proceed. 

Lead Specialists and Associate Product Managers in accomplishing objectives. 

Manage the lifecycle of the product. Product ranges will be expanded and maintained based on market needs and lifecycle. 

Establish and maintain a pricing strategy to global sales subsidiaries. 

Manage and implement Product Notification Change process globally. 

Manage quality issues and organize and lead team tasked to resolve issues. 

Develop and maintain a market and competition overview for the products managed. 

Launch products to other regional business units and subsidiaries within the business unit’s area of responsibility. 

Travel to industry events, customers and subsidiaries to obtain data and support product launches.   

Write functional specifications, customer value proposition statements, and expected benefit or loss (if not implemented) of a product or application concept. 

Lead the coordination of the development project according to the recognized and published Phoenix Contact global standards. 

Provide guidance to the engineering and manufacturing resources on individual approved projects.   

Develop the subsidiary sales organization through application-based training programs and joint sales efforts. 

Other duties as assigned by one’s Manager 

 

Qualifications 

 

BS Degree in Engineering or a Business Administration Degree in Marketing/Sales. 

MBA and/or relevant professional certifications preferred but not required. 

5 (+) years of relevant professional level experience preferred. 

Knowledge of current project and product management procedures and the proven ability to implement them, as demonstrated by completion of the PDMA New Product Development Professional (NPDP) or equivalent certification or experience. 

Demonstrated ability to lead multi-disciplined, international and cross-culture teams in a product development project. 

Excellent organizational skills and ability to work independently. 

Proven track record of problem solving  by analyzing  situation and providing recommended path forward.  

Experience with the creation and negotiation of business contracts is a plus. 

Leadership, mentorship, and training skills.

Job Summary 

 

A Quality Engineer II is responsible for investigating returned products and customer complaints to determine root cause, implement corrective and preventive actions, and ensure alignment with internal and external quality standards. This role combines hands-on failure analysis with broader quality engineering responsibilities, including supporting the Quality Management System (QMS), contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, and driving customer-focused quality outcomes. In addition, a Quality Engineer II may provide quality-related guidance during product development efforts and/or the establishment of quality systems. Success in this role includes but is not limited to identifying quality-related improvement opportunities for products and processes and ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards. Quality Engineer II is the second level within the Quality Engineer career path. 

 

Responsibilities 

 

Failure Analysis (Core Responsibilities) 

Perform detailed failure analysis on returned products (RMAs) using established procedures and product specifications 

Conduct functional, electrical, and mechanical testing to replicate and validate customer-reported issues 

Identify root causes and document findings in formal failure analysis and 4D reports 

Enter and manage failure analysis data within enterprise systems (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent) 

Communicate results clearly to internal stakeholders and customers, including conclusions and recommended actions 

Collaborate with manufacturing, design engineering, and suppliers when advanced analysis is required 

Support prioritization and processing of RMAs based on business needs and customer impact 

Maintain complete and accurate documentation, including test data and supporting evidence

Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions based on failure analysis findings 

Establishes inspection criteria for machines, equipment, materials, components, and/or products. 

Assists with leading quality audits for processes and products.   

Prepares summaries and trend analysis of quality issues and provides recommendations for corrective and preventive action.  

Contributes to Phoenix Contact Quality Management System (QMS), documentation, record keeping, and compliance.

The Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II is a senior-level individual contributor responsible for the governance, quality, integrity, and strategic management of enterprise master data across regional and global business operations. Working closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, IT teams, and global governance organizations, the Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II drives the development and execution of data standards, quality controls, and governance practices that support operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and informed business decision-making. Although the Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II does not have direct people management responsibilities, the role provides leadership through expertise, influence, and collaboration. The Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II independently manages complex initiatives, mentors stakeholders on master data management best practices, and drives alignment between regional business requirements and global data strategies to maximize the value of enterprise master data. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

 

Lead the regional execution of global master data governance strategies, policies, standards, and operating procedures across assigned data domains. 

Partner with global governance teams to define, implement, and continuously improve master data standards, governance frameworks, and stewardship processes that support business objectives. 

Serve as the regional subject matter expert and authority for master data definitions, ownership models, governance practices, and system-of-record strategies. 

Ensure alignment of global and regional master data definitions, business rules, and governance requirements across enterprise transactional systems, MDM platforms, integrations, and analytical environments. 

Establish, maintain, and govern enterprise data standards, including mandatory attributes, naming conventions, reference data usage, validation criteria, deduplication rules, survivorship logic, and field-level quality controls. 

Lead the identification, analysis, root cause investigation, and resolution of complex master data quality issues impacting multiple systems, functions, and business units.

metadata.name: Job Description
metadata.value:
This is a hands-on, activity-driven role ideal for someone who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow within a dynamic team responsible for driving sales of all Phoenix Contact products by combining engineering knowledge with strong interpersonal and business skills. The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) plays a key role on the regional sales team by providing leadership and direction in the establishment, development, and growth of assigned Regional Strategic Accounts. This position will carry out responsibilities in all of the following functions and areas: creating strategic plans, communicating direction, implementing corporate business reviews, creating corporate road-maps, expanding relationships (Maintain and develop relationships at all levels of Management, Procurement, Operations, and Quality Assurance, Engineering, Sales, and Estimating/quotations departments), analysis and recommendations, corporate price negotiations, and leading cross-functional teams.
Responsibilities
•	Meet or exceed sales quotas as established by the RSM and/or Vice President—Field Sales.
•	Be proficient in BASE selling skills and implement to build strong customer relationships.
•	Lead the charge in development of a strategic plan and implementation of strategic initiatives for regional strategic accounts. The focus includes increasing account share, revenue growth, profitability, building and expanding relationships with major stakeholders, increasing product mix, and expanding the Phoenix Contact brand.
•	Develop strategic roadmaps for strategic assigned accounts providing direction and insight on revenue generating locations. 
•	Develop intimate insight into the customer culture, needs, and supply chain, including key metrics leading to the recommendation of plans, initiatives, and/or corrective actions to provide the highest level of service to the customer’s organization.
•	Lead and coordinate established business reviews with the assigned strategic accounts, including monitoring of competitive activity, leading to recommendations to the Phoenix Contact team on areas of improvement.
•	Organize and lead cross functional teams with the appropriate members of Phoenix Contact for the purpose of building and maintaining trusting relationships between Phoenix Contact and assigned strategic accounts.
•	Support the preparation of proposals, presentations, and sales materials.
•	Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate client information. Fully utilize the CRM as a communication, reporting, measurement, and tracking tool to enhance productivity.
•	Collaborate with the entire Phoenix Contact team to align efforts, effectively communicate both verbally and written.
•	Track and report on business development activities and performance metrics.
•	Differentiate Phoenix Contact from other component vendors by building “partner” relationships with customers.
•	Be proficient in and drive the use of all sales tools provided to support local markets.
•	Work closely with Harrisburg Product teams to aid in the development of field presentations and application notes.
•	Proactively utilize all resources and sales tools to maximize productivity, responsiveness, and customer delight.
•	Continue personal development through an effective skill-building program as determined by the RSM, Director of Sales, and/or the Harrisburg Training Department.
•	Demonstrate technical competence on all products/solutions within the area of focus.
•	Provide forecasts and reports to RSM as required.
•	Deliver presentations and hands-on demonstrations of Phoenix Contact products, applications, and technology for the purpose of product sales.
•	Develop and maintain a working knowledge on all Phoenix Contact products/solutions.
•	Qualify and follow up on all opportunities within the assigned strategic accounts.
•	Follow up on all quotations within the assigned strategic account portfolio.
Qualifications
•	Four-year degree preferred.
•	Technical discipline preferred and/or equivalent experience.
•	5+ years minimum sales experience in the electronics or industrial automation & controls marketplace.
•	Experience working with distribution preferred.
•	Excellent networking, and influencing skills needed to communicate at all levels.
•	Exhibits high-level interpersonal and negotiation skills.
•	Successful history in achieving strategic and sales targets.
•	Self-motivated with the ability to learn and adapt quickly.
Essential Job Functions
•	Must be able to travel via airplane.
•	Must have a valid driver’s license and be able to travel via automobile for up to six hours at a time.
•	Must be able to lift a minimum of 50 lbs.
•	Must be able to travel overnight 35%+ or as dictated by assigned strategic account locations.
•	Comply with company dress code guidelines.
•	Punctuality is required.
•	Regular and on-time attendance.
